title: feat(spec)!: one-way sync-in, the spec half — datasource source, paging and delete policy keys, the pull refusals, and the synced bucket (ADR-0153)
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzh7cM8EmUX4T2CBNHX

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB3pCabRizVccNNEcB69Bep6)_

Fixes #32061

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #32065 (carrier note 6762847427 names skills/objectstack-data/**, skills/objectstack-schema/** and the sync-in guide)
Prior rulings read: 6303358360 (#24948 letter B: stands, `synced` not added to `outlivesOrganization`); ADR-0153 D1–D4 and the P2-spec row of its children table; ADR-0103 D1 (the named exception); ADR-0049; card thread: 0 rulings of 3 comments (`check-prior-rulings --card 32061`)
Carried: #32062 (P2 engine) flips each `planned` row (`datasourceSource`, `connectorSource.paging`, `.deletePolicy`, `.deletedField`) to `live` and drops `authorWarn`, and lifts the runtime `judgeJobPull` refusal of a mapping with no `connectorSource`

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：ADR-0153 sync-in 的 spec 半边：新键 `datasourceSource`、`connectorSource.paging` / `deletePolicy` / `deletedField`（均为 `planned` + `authorWarn`），带源 mapping 的解析与 `defineStack` 拒绝规则，`managedBy: 'synced'` 连同全部执行机制（写守卫、apiMethods 对账、`/me/permissions` 钳制、两处镜像、ui 桶联合），`_sync_` 字段名保留，`security-owd-unset` 的 synced 修复建议。
- **为什么改**：ADR-0153 P2 spec 子卡：引擎卡（#32062）读这些键之前，先把契约和"写进去就会坏"的组合在作者处拒掉；安全桶不能不带执行机制落地（ADR-0049）。
- **风险与回滚**：收窄（BREAKING）：现有带 `connectorSource` 的 mapping 必须 `mode: 'upsert'` + `upsertKey` 且目标对象为 `synced`；任何对象上 `_sync_` 前缀字段被拒。两条 ADR-0087 迁移条目已登记。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts#collectSourcedMappingErrors`、`packages/spec/src/data/mapping.zod.ts`（MappingSchema 的 superRefine 和 `datasourceSource`）、`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts#resolveCrudAffordances`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/data/mapping-sync-in.test.ts src/data/object-managed-by-synced.test.ts`，预期两文件全绿：每条拒绝在最小 stack 上触发，合法孪生静默。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**New keys (ADR-0153 D1–D3), each a `planned` liveness row under `authorWarn`.**
- `mapping.datasourceSource: { object, watermark: { field, start }, full?, deletePolicy?, deletedField? }`, a sibling of `connectorSource`.
- `connectorSource.paging: { style: 'page' | 'cursor' | 'offset' | 'none', param?, nextPath? }`, `connectorSource.deletePolicy: 'mark' | 'ignore'`, `connectorSource.deletedField`. `deletePolicy` has **no schema default** (absence reads as `mark`; pinned that a parse adds no key).
- `job.pull` accepts a mapping with either source (`collectJobPullMappingErrors`).

**Refusals, live as they land.**
- Parse (`MappingSchema` refinement): exclusive source; a sourced mapping is `mode: 'upsert'` with a non-empty `upsertKey`; `paging` states the parameter its style needs and `none` states none.
- `defineStack` (`collectSourcedMappingErrors`, `STACK_CROSS_REFERENCE_INVALID` / 422): sourced `targetObject` must be `managedBy: 'synced'` (either source); `datasourceSource.object` must be an object of the stack and federated (`external`); `source_key_missing`; `source_key_not_exact` (string, or integer `scale: 0` with `precision` ≤ 15); halvable `watermark.field` (`datetime`, `date`, integer number); `watermark_not_exact`; `watermark_field_unmapped`.
- `_sync_` field-name reservation on any object and object extension (a second key pattern, so the published JSON Schema states it too; `fieldPatches` unchanged).

**`managedBy: 'synced'` with every mechanism (ADR-0153 D4).**
- Enum value; affordance row = `engine-owned`'s; `userActions` may not open a write verb (named exception to ADR-0103 D1): refused at parse (`userActions.<verb>`) and closed by `resolveCrudAffordances` via the new exported `MANAGED_BY_WRITE_LOCKED_BUCKETS`.
- Engine write guard `ENGINE_OWNED_BUCKETS` (plugin-security) takes `synced`, with its own 403 message.
- `apiMethods` reconciliation strips every write method (driven by the resolver).
- `/me/permissions` clamp: `GUARDED_WRITE_BUCKETS` takes `synced`, and reads the closed row even when `userActions` opens a verb.
- Both `PLATFORM_INTERNAL_MANAGED_BUCKETS` mirrors (objectql `rule-validator.ts`, lint `validate-readonly-flow-writes.ts`), each pinned against the spec enum.
- `ui/packages/types` `ManagedByBucket` union and `MANAGED_BY_BUCKETS`.
- Readers that keep their answer were verified, not edited, and pinned to skip `synced`: `user-assigned-work`, both `claim-seed-ownership` passes, the install-local seed owner. `outlivesOrganization` does **not** take `synced` (ruling 6303358360, #24948 letter B, stands); pinned.

**Lint.** `security-owd-unset` on a synced object recommends `sharingModel: 'public_read'` (a pulled row has no person owner), or `'private'` with a read sharing rule.

**Guidance.** `CONNECTOR_SOURCE_NO_POLICY`: `deleteMode` now points at `deletePolicy`.

## Tests

- New: `packages/spec/src/data/mapping-sync-in.test.ts` (every parse and build refusal on a minimal stack beside its legal twin; `job.pull` with a `datasourceSource`), `packages/spec/src/data/object-managed-by-synced.test.ts` (bucket row, `userActions` refusal and resolver clamp, `_sync_` reservation), `packages/objectql/src/synced-outlives-organization.test.ts`.
- Extended: plugin-security `system-write-guard.test.ts` (member write refused, even with `userActions`; system pull passes); objectql `registry.test.ts` (reconciliation offers no write method) and `static-readonly-insert-subject-buckets.test.ts` (mirror vs enum); core `effective-object-permissions.test.ts` (clamp returns the closed row with `userActions: { edit: true }`) and `user-assigned-work.test.ts`; lint `validate-readonly-flow-writes.test.ts` (mirror vs enum) and `validate-security-posture.test.ts` (synced fix-it); organizations and cloud-connection seed-owner tests (skip `synced`).
- Updated for the narrowing: `mapping-connector-source.test.ts`, `job-pull-organization.test.ts`, `object.test.ts` (published key pattern).

**Ablation readings** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty each time):
- Guard set without `synced` (`system-write-guard.ts`): `system-write-guard.test.ts` 3 failed | 14 passed (17).
- Synced-target refusal disabled (`stack.zod.ts`): 3 spec files 1 failed | 56 passed (57).

## Acceptance notes

1. **Private-synced-without-read-sharing-rule warning: not implemented.** The ADR's P2-spec row places only the `security-owd-unset` fix-it in this child; no child row of ADR-0153 places the warning. It needs a home (likely the P3 guide/Studio child or a lint card).
2. **`watermark_field_unmapped` at build is judged for `datasourceSource` only.** A connector source's watermark is a response path, not a field of a stack object, so the build cannot type it; the executor's runtime check stays.
3. **Error codes.** The refusal names (`source_key_missing`, …) are finding names inside the `STACK_CROSS_REFERENCE_INVALID` envelope, like the executor's reasons, so no ADR-0112 code was registered.

Also: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/components/ManagedByBadge.tsx` (private, not in the claim) needed a one-line type exclusion so the console compiles with the new bucket; its badge for `synced` is left to the Studio child. ADR-0153's status line still reads Proposed.
